name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It sharpens fine details in complex scenes—like foliage or textured surfaces—better than standard upscalers, giving a measurable quality bump. The trade-off is a 10-15% slowdown in upscaling time, but the clarity gain outweighs the delay for high-stakes outputs.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a temporal artifact, not a spatial one. The real risk is wasting 10-15% throughput on a dead-end patch while motion blur persists. Try VFI-Flow’s temporal interpolation first; if it drops frames below 30fps, the trade-off is clear—no upscaler fixes what motion breaks.
